items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He's a friend's house. To talk. We went in there to talk. And chat a little while.

ctx.x: 1927? Yeah. Around 1927. Is that about when they made the records? Or were the records made later?

No. All the records was made around in about 1930. The records was made. Around in 1930. We cut those records. And I taken the two records. And I put them on my seat at automobile. And I went in the corner. Willie Pazio was playing trumpet. And. He's a very good trumpet player. Also. Willie Pazio was playing trumpet. And. I went. Over. In. He's a friend's house. To talk. We went in there to talk. And chat a little while. And when I come out there. Then took the two records off the seat. I didn't lock the car.
